Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: The Login message is the first message sent to the Spin Server by a user's process after the connection to the Spin Server is established. Failure to login before sending any other message type will result in the connection being dropped by the Spin Server. The format of the Login message for the Spin Server is identical to that of the GRP.

Field.Name: SessionSubId
Field.Description: SessionSubId supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Username supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: (space filled)

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password supplied by Cboe.

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: The Login Response message is sent by the Spin Server to a user's process in response to a Login message. The status field is used to reflect an accepted login or the reason the session was not accepted. If login fails, the connection will be dropped after the Login Response message is sent.

Field.Name: Login Response Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject.

Message.Name: Spin Image Available Message
Message.Description: The Spin Image Available message is sent once per second and indicates through what sequence number a spin is available.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Spin is available which is current through this sequence number.

Message.Name: Spin Request Message
Message.Description: The Spin Request message is used by a user's process to request transmission of a spin of the unit's order book.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from a Spin Image Available message received by the customer.

Message.Name: Spin Response Message
Message.Description: The Spin Response message is sent in response to a user's Spin Request message indicating whether a spin will be sent.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from a Spin Image Available message received by the customer.

Field.Name: Order Count
Field.Description: Always zero.

Field.Name: Spin Response Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject. All non-A status codes should be interpreted as a reject.

Message.Name: Spin Finished Message
Message.Description: The Spin Finished message is sent to indicate that all messages for the spin requested have been sent. A Spin Finished message is only sent if a Spin Request was not rejected. Upon receipt of a Spin Finished message, any buffered multicast messages should be applied to the customer's copy of the book to make it current.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Sequence number from the Spin Request message.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Request Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Request message is used by a user's process to request transmission of this unit's Symbol Mappings and Complex Instrument Definitions. All Symbol Mapping messages will be sent before Complex Instrument Definition Expanded and Exchange Designated Complex Instrument Definition messages.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Must be 0. Only the current Symbol Mappings and Complex Instrument Definitions are available.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Response Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Response message is sent in response to a user's Instrument Definition Request message indicating whether a spin will be sent.

Field.Name: Sequence
Field.Description: Will always be 0.

Field.Name: Instrument Count
Field.Description: Number of Symbol Mapping and Complex Instrument Definition Expanded (if applicable) messages which will be contained in this spin.

Field.Name: Instrument Definition Response Status
Field.Description: Accepted or reason for reject.

Message.Name: Instrument Definition Finished Message
Message.Description: The Instrument Definition Finished message is sent to indicate that all Symbol Mapping and Complex Instrument Definition Expanded messages for this unit have been sent. An Instrument Definition Finished message is only sent if an Instrument Definition Request was not rejected.

Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is immediately generated and sent when there is a Top event for a given clock second. If there is no Top event for a given clock second, then no Time message is sent for that second. All subsequent time offset fields for the same unit will use the new Time value as the base until another Time message is received for the same unit. On C1 only, the Time message will also include the Epoch Time field, which is the current time represented as the number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970).

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds elapsed since the start of the current Eastern Time calendar day, derived by converting the current Eastern wall clock time (HH:MM:SS) to seconds.

Field.Name: Epoch Time
Field.Description: C1 Options Only. Number of whole seconds since the Epoch (midnight January 1, 1970 UTC).

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: A Symbol Mapping message is used to map the 6 character simple instrument multicast feed symbol field to an OSI symbol and Underlying. These messages are not sequenced (sequence = 0) and are sent continuously through the day at variable rates as bandwidth allows.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol.

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: N = Normal, C = Closing Only.

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces. All spaces if not available or not applicable.

Message.Name: Complex Instrument Definition Expanded Message
Message.Description: A Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message represents a complex instrument that is available to place orders. It is sent as a sequenced message. Complex Instrument Definition Expanded messages will be sent in a continuous loop through the day at variable rates as bandwidth allows. The Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message will contain two or more repeating groups of leg definitions. There is a limit of 16 leg definitions.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Underlying
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Type
Field.Description: Character field; each field describes a characteristic. Character 1: Complex Option Type. Characters 2-4: Reserved.

Field.Name: Leg Count
Field.Description: The number of legs in the complex instrument. The maximum number of legs is 16.

Field.Name: Complex Leg
Field.Description: Repeating group of leg definitions, repeats Leg Count times.

Message.Name: Exchange Designated Complex Instrument Definition Message
Message.Description: C1 Options Only. The Exchange Designated Complex Instrument Definition (EDCID) message represents supplemental information associated with an exchange-designated complex instrument and is sent as a sequenced message the first time it is sent. These messages are also sent continuously throughout the day as an unsequenced message (sequence = 0) at variable rates as bandwidth allows. The Time offset field should be ignored on unsequenced EDCID messages. This message is sent in addition to a Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message for each exchange-designated complex instrument.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Underlying
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: EDCI Type
Field.Description: Exchange Designated Complex Instrument type right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: EDCI Subtype
Field.Description: Exchange Designated Complex Instrument subtype right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Leg Count
Field.Description: The number of legs in the complex instrument. The maximum number of legs is 16.

Field.Name: EDCID Leg
Field.Description: Repeating group of leg definitions, repeats Leg Count times.

Message.Name: Single Side Update Expanded (Short) Message
Message.Description: Single Side Update messages provide an updated price and size for a single side of a Complex Instrument ID. The side is denoted by the Side field. One Single Side Update message may reflect one or more updates to the inside book that were processed at the same time, but will only be done so in a way that can be arbitrated between A/B feeds. The Single Side Update Expanded (Short) message is used whenever possible.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: B = Bid Side, S = Ask Side.

Field.Name: Bit Fields
Field.Description: Bits 0-7 - Reserved. There are no Bit Fields for Complex Multicast TOP.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price (may be a zero or negative price for some instruments).

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of contracts on the inside book (customer and non-customer). A zero value denotes there is no Bid/Ask.

Field.Name: Customer Quantity
Field.Description: Number of customer contracts on the inside book. A zero value denotes that there are no customer contracts at the inside price.

Message.Name: Single Side Update Expanded (Long) Message
Message.Description: Single Side Update messages provide an updated price and size for a single side of a Complex Instrument ID. The Single Side Update Expanded (Long) message is used when the Price cannot be represented by a Binary Short Price or the Quantity cannot be represented by an unsigned 16-bit integer.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: B = Bid Side, S = Ask Side.

Field.Name: Bit Fields
Field.Description: Bits 0-7 - Reserved. There are no Bit Fields for Complex Multicast TOP.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price (may be a zero or negative price for some instruments).

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of contracts on the inside book (customer and non-customer). A zero value denotes there is no Bid/Ask.

Field.Name: Customer Quantity
Field.Description: Number of customer contracts on the inside book. A zero value denotes that there are no customer contracts at the inside price.

Message.Name: Two Side Update Expanded (Short) Message
Message.Description: Two Side Update messages provide an updated price and size for both sides of a Complex Instrument ID. One Two Side Update message may reflect one or more updates to the inside book that were processed at the same time, but will only be done so in a way that can be arbitrated between A/B feeds. The Two Side Update Expanded (Short) message is used whenever possible.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Bit Fields
Field.Description: Bits 0-7 - Reserved. There are no Bit Fields for Complex Multicast TOP.

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Bid Price (may be a zero or negative price for some instruments).

Field.Name: Bid Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of contracts on the inside bid (customer and non-customer). A zero value denotes there is no bid.

Field.Name: Bid Customer Quantity
Field.Description: Number of customer contracts on the inside bid. A zero value denotes that there are no customer contracts at the inside price.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: Ask Price (may be a zero or negative price for some instruments).

Field.Name: Ask Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of contracts on the inside ask (customer and non-customer). A zero value denotes there is no ask.

Field.Name: Ask Customer Quantity
Field.Description: Number of customer contracts on the inside ask. A zero value denotes that there are no customer contracts at the inside price.

Message.Name: Two Side Update Expanded (Long) Message
Message.Description: Two Side Update messages provide an updated price and size for both sides of a Complex Instrument ID. The Two Side Update Expanded (Long) message is used when the Price cannot be represented by a Binary Short Price or the Quantity cannot be represented by an unsigned 16-bit integer.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Bit Fields
Field.Description: Bits 0-7 - Reserved. There are no Bit Fields for Complex Multicast TOP.

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Bid Price (may be a zero or negative price for some instruments).

Field.Name: Bid Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of contracts on the inside bid (customer and non-customer). A zero value denotes there is no bid.

Field.Name: Bid Customer Quantity
Field.Description: Number of customer contracts on the inside bid. A zero value denotes that there are no customer contracts at the inside price.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: Ask Price (may be a zero or negative price for some instruments).

Field.Name: Ask Quantity
Field.Description: Total number of contracts on the inside ask (customer and non-customer). A zero value denotes there is no ask.

Field.Name: Ask Customer Quantity

Message.Name: TOP Trade Message
Message.Description: The TOP Trade message provides information about executions of complex orders. TOP Trade messages are necessary to calculate Cboe execution-based data. TOP Trade messages do not alter the complex book. One or more Single Side Update Expanded or Two Side Update Expanded messages will follow a TOP Trade message to reflect the updated complex book. The TOP Trade message sends the trade price, trade quantity, and trade condition of a trade as well as the cumulative volume for the business day.

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental quantity executed or cancelled (see Trade Condition).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Total Volume
Field.Description: Total quantity traded on the current business day (may decrease if the Trade Condition field indicates a cancelled trade).

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: See Options Trade Condition Codes for details.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a complex instrument. A Trading Status message will be sent whenever a complex instrument trading status changes. The Trading Status field will be used to represent the status of the RTH (9:30 a.m. ET - 4:15 p.m. ET) and Curb sessions. The GTH Trading Status field will be used to represent the status of series that trade during the GTH session. The GTH session runs from 8:15 p.m. to 9:25 a.m. ET for GTH-eligible Products (C1 only).

Field.Name: Time Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: H = Halted, L = Curb Trading (C1 Only), Q = Quote-Only, T = RTH Trading.

Field.Name: Reserved Filler
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: GTH Trading Status
Field.Description: C1 only. H = Halted, Q = Quote-Only, T = Trading.

Field.Name: Reserved2
Field.Description: Reserved

Group.Name: Complex Leg
Group.Description: Repeating leg definition group inside the Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message. Repeats Leg Count times.

Field.Name: Leg Symbol
Field.Description: Option or Equity Symbol of leg, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio (positive for buy-side, negative for sell-side). For options this is the number of contracts, for equities this is the number of shares.

Field.Name: Leg Security Type
Field.Description: O = Leg is an Option instrument, E = Leg is an Equity instrument.

Group.Name: EDCID Leg
Group.Description: Repeating leg definition group inside the Exchange Designated Complex Instrument Definition message. Repeats Leg Count times.

Field.Name: Leg Symbol
Field.Description: Option symbol of leg, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio (positive for buy-side, negative for sell-side).

Bitfield.Name: Bit Fields
Bitfield.Description: Reserved bit field used in Single Side Update and Two Side Update messages. All 8 bits are reserved for Complex Multicast TOP.

Field.Name: Reserved Bits
Field.Description: Bits 0-7 - Reserved. There are no Bit Fields for Complex Multicast TOP.
